source.text: Paravoor Govindan Devarajan, popularly known as G. Devarajan or Devarajan master, was an Indian music composer. He is considered one of the greatest music directors in Indian film music arena. He scored music for more than three hundred Malayalam films, many dramas, and twenty Tamil and four Kannada movies. Many of his compositions remain ever green classics in Malayalam. His music in the Tamil film "Annai Velankanni" has received many accolades. Devarajan received Kerala Government's Best Music Director award five times, among other honours. He is regarded as the greatest music composer ever in the history of Malayalam cinema.
source.title: G. Devarajan

source.text: Darsanam is a 1973 Indian Malayalam film, directed by P. N. Menon and produced by P. C. George. The film stars Adoor Bhasi, Supriya, Sankaradi and Raghavan in the lead roles. The film had musical score by G. Devarajan.
source.title: Darsanam
